A settlement where strong drink, old jokes, and Sablewood craft turn danger into hospitality without making danger harmless. The Sable Stills are warm, smoky, and sharper than they seem, turning old wood, strong drink, and local jokes into hospitality with teeth. The Sable Stills should smell illegal before it looks illegal: copper coils, moss smoke, bubbling barrels, hidden paths, and workers insisting this is all for medicine. The place breaks into usable table spaces: Copper still yard: Coils and barrels create shiny clutter. Stream intake: Water feeds the operation quietly. Hidden storage lean-to: Crates and false walls hold secrets. Plants and materials: sugar moss, smoke-stained bark, stream herbs. Animals and background life: drunk beetles, sugar moths, bold mice near mash barrels. The air carries sweet sour smell, copper shine, bubbling, soft smoke. Water feeds mash, mash feeds stills, waste feeds insects, and insects draw birds...
